data.completion_memo: Created the Rust workspace and six isolated process crates plus a shared bounded smoke lifecycle seam. Each binary accepts a generation and completes a smoke handshake; cargo format and workspace tests pass.
data.description: Create the Cargo workspace and crate/binary layout for the Trusted Core, Workflow Worker, Capability Host, Local Store, Portable Store, and Bootstrap Helper. Add minimal generation-aware startup and bounded shutdown entry points while enforcing the designed dependency directions; feature behavior is out of scope. The result must compile and each process entry point must complete a smoke handshake.
data.title: M01.1 — Scaffold the Rust workspace and process boundaries
